title: MapleStory M Maple Guide
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: Official instructions for opening Maple Guide at level 50, browsing level-based hunting grounds and content, filtering by type or reward, and checking difficulty and obtainable rewards.

sections.title: Access and recommendations
items: Maple Guide becomes available at level 50 and opens from the main Menu.
Recommendations can follow the current character level or a level selected on the level bar.
Recommended hunting grounds and content use a dedicated guide icon.

sections.title: Recommended hunting grounds
items: The hunting-ground view lists locations appropriate for the selected level and above.
Selecting a recommended hunting ground opens that hunting ground's interface.
Move the level bar left or right to compare recommendations across levels.

sections.title: Recommended and level-based content
items: Content entries show type, difficulty, level requirements, and obtainable rewards.
Selecting a content entry opens the corresponding content interface.
The level-based list can be reviewed independently from the recommended-content list.

sections.title: Filters and rewards
items: The Content by Level filter narrows entries by content type or reward.
Reward tooltips show the obtainable rewards attached to a content entry.
Recheck the current interface after major UI updates because menu placement can change.

notes: Structured summary verified from Nexon's official MapleStory M forum guide on 2026-07-27.
prerequisites: A MapleStory M character at level 50 or above
steps: Open Maple Guide from the main Menu.
Choose the current level or move the level bar to another level.
Review recommended hunting grounds and content.
Use the content-type or reward filter to narrow the level-based list.
Open an entry to view its content interface and reward details.
